decision.reasoning_trace: The product feed included several items that were actually protective cases rather than speakers, which I excluded immediately. I narrowed my search to the best-reviewed speakers across various price points. My consideration set includes a premium Bose speaker, a flashy JBL model, and three highly-rated value options. I ultimately selected the Raymate speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_153) because it offers an impressive balance of features—30W output, IPX7 waterproofing, and a 4.6-star rating—at a very reasonable price compared to the high-end brands. The customer reviews highlighted it as a 'powerhouse' and an 'excellent value,' making it the most pragmatic choice for a high-quality portable audio experience.
